Preparation owns source and target descriptors, fences target before restoring, uses consistent SQLite/object snapshot and current restore quarantine, then verifies target deployment
Source main/WAL/journal continuity, target database/objects and restore-report proofs rechecked before and after manager wait; no checkpoint or discarding foreign SQLite state
Native absence uses registration inspect port, not an incomplete ordinary query; Linux system can explicitly pin original uninstall operation/root endpoint/bundle for inspect/close only

Cancellation/manager cleanup failure retains actual task and locks; no implicit native change, elevation, startup or readiness success
Recovery plans require original installation capture and original snapshot SHA; first snapshot failed version, then restore into another fresh home without overriding either version
Independent bounded hash-linked maintenance audit and CLI plan/prepare/select/inspect/abandon/recovery-plan; no chat bodies, credential copying or V1 imports
